title: AI Sensing and Intervention in Higher Education: Student Perceptions of Learning Impacts, Affective Responses, and Ethical Priorities
reasoning: The paper includes a primary research stage (Stage 2) and research question (RQ2) specifically dedicated to the evaluation and prioritization of ethical concerns. It uses a structured experimental approach (pairwise ranking) to analyze how students weigh ethical principles like autonomy, privacy, fairness, and transparency in the context of AI-driven education.
